ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 70:30 ratio of high-intensity (white) to low-intensity (black/grey) pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant white contiguous fields occupy the central-lateral zones of both lobes. High-density dark pigmentation (black) forms a continuous band along the trailing edge, thickening towards the median notch. Scattered low-intensity focal spots (mottling) are distributed throughout the high-intensity white regions.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, acute V-shaped depression with a calculated angle of approximately 45-50 degrees at the central convergence.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations with pixel-amplitudes of 5-15 pixels relative to the mean edge line; prominent jagged peaks are visible on the distal third of both the left and right lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curvature following a parabolic arc along the trailing edge, terminating in sharply tapered distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Clusters of dark-on-white circular mottling located primarily in the lower-inner quadrants of both lobes near the peduncle; white-on-dark clusters visible at the extreme distal tips.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Faint, unaligned dark linear streaks detected on the medial section of the right lobe, disrupting the white pixel field.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Ragged, non-linear pixel disruptions at the distal tips of both lobes indicating historical tissue loss or trauma.
